description: This file contains shared utility functions, type definitions, constants, and command parsing logic for handling ACP (Agent Control Protocol) commands within a larger software project. It defines command usage strings, action types, input parsing functions, and error handling for ACP command processing.

methods.name: stopWithText
methods.description: Creates a CommandHandlerResult that stops further command processing and replies with the provided text.

methods.name: resolveAcpAction
methods.description: Determines the ACP action type from command tokens.

methods.name: readOptionValue
methods.description: Reads and normalizes command-line option values, handling '--option' and '--option=value' formats.

methods.name: normalizeAcpOptionToken
methods.description: Normalizes tokens by trimming and converting unicode dashes to standard '--' prefix.

methods.name: resolveDefaultSpawnThreadMode
methods.description: Determines default thread mode based on channel support and current thread ID.

methods.name: parseSpawnInput
methods.description: Parses tokens for the /acp spawn command, extracting agent ID, mode, thread, bind, cwd, and label.

methods.name: parseSteerInput
methods.description: Parses tokens for the /acp steer command, extracting session token and instruction.

methods.name: parseSingleValueCommandInput
methods.description: Parses tokens for commands expecting a single value, with optional session token.

methods.name: parseSetCommandInput
methods.description: Parses tokens for the /acp set command, extracting key, value, and optional session token.

methods.name: parseOptionalSingleTarget
methods.description: Parses tokens that may contain an optional session token.

methods.name: resolveAcpHelpText
methods.description: Returns a help text string listing available ACP commands and notes.

methods.name: formatRuntimeOptionsText
methods.description: Formats runtime options into a human-readable string.

methods.name: formatAcpCapabilitiesText
methods.description: Formats a list of controls into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: resolveCommandRequestId
methods.description: Generates a request ID based on message context or a new UUID.

methods.name: collectAcpErrorText
methods.description: Converts an error into a standardized ACP runtime error text.

methods.name: withAcpCommandErrorBoundary
methods.description: Executes an async function with error handling, returning a CommandHandlerResult.
